claims: On Friday, April 10, 2026, Las Vegas honored Bruno Mars with a celebratory parade down the Strip.
On Friday, April 10, 2026, Las Vegas named Bruno Mars the "new king of Las Vegas".
The procession moved from the Bellagio Fountains to Toshiba Plaza.
Park Avenue became "Bruno Mars Drive" during a street renaming ceremony.
The parade started at 1 p.m. on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The parade began near the Bellagio.
The parade traveled down Las Vegas Boulevard past the Cosmopolitan, Aria, and Park MGM.
The parade ended at T-Mobile Arena's Toshiba Plaza.
Governor Lombardo gave a key to the city to Bruno Mars.
Bruno Mars pledged a $1 million donation to a local children's hospital.
Bruno Mars and his band, The Hooligans, performed at Toshiba Plaza following the parade.
The event coincided with Bruno Mars's April 10-11 stop at Allegiant Stadium for "The Romantic Tour".
The honor recognizes Bruno Mars's over 15-year history of performing in Las Vegas.
Bruno Mars has a popular "Pinky Ring" lounge in Las Vegas.
